main_measure.name: excess forward 20-bar return on short blocks vs all-bar mean

statistic.name: one-sample t of mean excess across short blocks

main_measure.threshold: confirm if excess < 0 with t <= -2 (slope not positive); reject if excess > 0 with t >= +2; else inconclusive; at least 6 short blocks (120 short bars)

supporting_check.name: slope of forward 20-bar return on |forecast| within short blocks (should be <= 0)

reading: Blocks start at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window; a short block starts on a bar with a negative forecast; the baseline is the pooled mean forward 20-bar return over all block starts of all windows; the t is the one-sample t of the excess across short blocks; the slope uses |forecast| on short blocks; the minimum requires both 6 blocks and 120 short bars.
